description: Publish media, files and generated web content from ChatGPT to usable Media2URL links.

defaultPrompt: Publish this HTML and give me a live URL.
Give me the direct image URL for Markdown.
Update the live page without changing its URL.
interface.longDescription: Publish ChatGPT-created files, images, video, audio, PDFs, and HTML through Media2URL. Sign in to a connected Media2URL account before uploading or updating content. Free accounts include 90 uploads per month (roughly 3 per day); paid plans unlock larger quotas and advanced controls. Choose direct file URLs for code and embeds, share pages for people, or managed updates that preserve existing URLs.

name: media2url-chatgpt-plugin
